description: Asks Clara, the First assistant, a question for the customer. Use it for a general question about prenups (prenuptial agreements), for example "Do I need a prenup?" or "What can a prenup cover?", and for a question about First. Clara knows the First app and the general legal points of a prenup. When the customer is signed in, Clara also knows the customer's account. Send only the customer's question. Send the thread_id of an earlier answer to continue that conversation. Before sign-in, the result has notice, terms_url, and privacy_url: show the notice to the customer with the first answer, with both links.

product.description: The product line that the question is about. Leave it out for a general question.

thread_id.description: The thread_id of an earlier ask_clara answer.

name: ask_clara
title: Ask Clara
